record.question: State whether the following statements are True or False: (a) In case the Government servant's copy of his Service Book is lost by him, it shall be replaced on payment of a sum of Rs. 500. (b) It shall be the responsibility of the officers maintaining the Service Book to complete and certify the Service Books in respect of previous service in the 20th year of service or 5 years before the retirement, whichever is less. (c) In April each year, the Government servant shall hand over his copy of the Service Book to his office for updation. (d) A record of the services of all Government servants will be kept by such Audit Officer and in such form as the Comptroller and Auditor-General may prescribe. (e) The subordinate Gazetted Officers who are delegated powers to attest entries in the Service Books of Gazetted Officers are also authorized to keep these documents in their custody and to attest entries in the leave account.
